review_comments:
This is slightly faster as it avoids 2 round trips into the executor. Now this is not performance sensitive code so feel free to ignore.

```suggestion
                def work():
                    self.verisure.mfa_validate(user_input[CONF_CODE], True)
                    self.verisure.login()

                await self.hass.async_add_executor_job(work)
```

Initially commited the suggestion, but reverting it.

While a small nice optimization, `mypy` doesn't understand it:

```
homeassistant/components/verisure/config_flow.py:112: error: Value of type "Optional[Dict[str, Any]]" is not indexable  [index]
```

It simply lost the `None` check just above it. I'm not going to fight typing or adding ignore comments for this tiny performance gain that only is a win during the (rare) setup procedure.
